hypothesis: Expose the existing environment and agent tab descriptions in accessible static HTML while preserving the interactive explorer and avoiding duplicate padding.

selection.definition: 100 * frozen geo_eval site_cited cells / 60, including bare project-domain occurrences under the existing judge
selection.validity: All 60 frozen query-engine cells must be valid; otherwise remain unranked
selection.baseline: Best measured R9: 8/60, composite 30.25000; reused historical measurement, not a simultaneous control
selection.current_production: R12, 6/60, discard; do not lower the selection bar to current production
selection.deployment: Separate explicit publication approval required for R13; verify exact candidate tree and served bytes before/after 60 real probes
selection.history: Retain all candidates and original proposals for combinations; never add parent scores
selection.limitations: Immediate single samples and historical controls do not establish causality or exclude indexing lag; no automatic rollback or follow-up

deployment_plan: After separate R13 approval, apply the exact candidate index.html in an isolated deploy branch based on then-current main and verify the complete tree. Do not blindly merge a historical-seed branch into production; preserve or reconcile any teammate changes.
